tasks.title: Wire src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx to MDX loader
tasks.description: Replace blogPosts import. generateStaticParams returns slugs from getAllPosts. generateMetadata uses post.seoDescription || post.excerpt, ogImage || coverImage, post.title. Page body: const post = await getPostBySlug(slug); if (!post) notFound(); const related = await getRelatedPosts(post); const seriesPosts = post.series ? (await getAllPosts()).filter(p => p.series?.name === post.series.name).sort((a,b)=>(a.series.part-b.series.part)) : undefined; render <BlogDetail post={post} seriesPosts={seriesPosts}><BlogDetailContent post={post} /></BlogDetail><RelatedPosts posts={related} />. See PRD §Page Wiring.
acceptance: generateStaticParams + generateMetadata populated from MDX directory
Unknown slug returns the not-found page rather than crashing
OG image, page title, and description populated from frontmatter
tasks.notes: Dynamic import path `../../../../content/blog/${slug}.mdx` is webpack-scanned at build. RelatedPosts adapter maps slug→id. Cascade closed — sub-agents can now drop structural-prop crutch.
